heading_en: Calculation of Specific Risk for Correlation Trading
summary_ja: コリレーション・トレーディングの個別リスクの算出には、修正標準方式による個別リスクの額を用いる。
summary_en: Requires use of the modified standardized approach when calculating specific risk for correlation trading.
paragraphs: In calculating specific risk for correlation trading, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall use the amount of specific risk calculated by the modified standardized approach prescribed in the following Article.
